meaning: A short friendly way to say hello.
example: Hi, how was your day?

meaning: An informal word to get attention or greet someone.
example: Hey, wait for me!

meaning: A short word you say when leaving.
example: Bye, see you tomorrow!

meaning: Used to agree or say that something is acceptable.
example: Okay, I will call you at six.
exampleTamil: சரி, நான் ஆறு மணிக்கு உன்னை அழைக்கிறேன்.

meaning: The cold season of the year, after autumn.
example: It gets very cold in the north during winter.

meaning: Used to agree, or to say that things are acceptable.
example: Alright, let us start the class.

meaning: Used to ask if something is true or to add strength.
example: Really? You won the prize?

meaning: An informal way of saying yes.
example: Yeah, I know that song.

meaning: An informal way of saying no.
example: Nope, I have not seen your keys.

meaning: A casual way of saying yes.
example: Yep, I am ready to go.

meaning: Used to show you are very surprised or impressed.
example: Wow, this cake is delicious!
exampleTamil: வாவ், இந்த கேக் மிகவும் சுவையாக இருக்கிறது!

meaning: Said when you make a small mistake.
example: Oops, I dropped my pen.

meaning: Said when you feel sudden pain.
example: Ouch, that hot tea burnt my tongue!
exampleTamil: ஆ, அந்த சூடான தேநீர் என் நாக்கைச் சுட்டுவிட்டது!

meaning: Very good; used to show you are happy about something.
example: That is great news, congratulations!

meaning: Very good or impressive; a casual word of praise.
example: The movie was awesome.

meaning: Very good; used for strong praise.
example: Your idea sounds super.

meaning: The time of day between afternoon and night.
example: We go for a walk every evening.

meaning: The time of day from noon until evening.
example: I take a short nap in the afternoon.

meaning: Twelve o'clock at night.
example: The train reached the station at midnight.

meaning: Twelve o'clock in the day.
example: Let us meet at noon for lunch.

meaning: The first light of the day, just before sunrise.
example: Farmers wake up at dawn.

meaning: Very bad weather with strong wind and heavy rain.
example: A big storm hit the town last night.
exampleTamil: நேற்றிரவு ஒரு பெரிய புயல் ஊரைத் தாக்கியது.

meaning: Soft white ice that falls from the sky in very cold places.
example: The children were excited to see snow for the first time.
exampleTamil: குழந்தைகள் முதல் முறையாக பனியைப் பார்த்து உற்சாகமடைந்தனர்.

meaning: At a time before now or before another time.
example: I told you earlier that I was busy.
exampleTamil: நான் பிஸியாக இருக்கிறேன் என்று உன்னிடம் முன்பே சொன்னேன்.

meaning: For all time; without ever ending.
example: I will remember this day forever.
exampleTamil: இந்த நாளை நான் என்றென்றும் நினைவில் வைத்திருப்பேன்.

meaning: Only; or a very short time ago.
example: I have just reached home.

meaning: Used to show something is surprising or extreme.
example: Even my little brother knows the answer.

meaning: Anything at all; used when you do not mind which.
example: Whatever you choose is fine with me.

meaning: A shout of joy when something good happens.
example: Hooray, we won the match!

meaning: Said when you feel relieved after a worry.
example: Phew, I found my wallet!

meaning: Said when something is unpleasant or disgusting.
example: Ugh, the milk has gone bad.

meaning: A sound you make when you are thinking or unsure.
example: Hmm, I am not sure about that.
exampleTamil: ம்ம், அதைப் பற்றி எனக்கு உறுதியாகத் தெரியவில்லை.

meaning: Said to wish someone safety when you part.
example: Take care and message me when you reach.
exampleTamil: பத்திரமாக இருங்கள், போய்ச் சேர்ந்ததும் எனக்குச் செய்தி அனுப்புங்கள்.

meaning: Words you say to wish someone success.
example: Good luck for your exam tomorrow!

meaning: Words of praise for good work.
example: Well done, you passed the test!

meaning: A common question to ask about someone's health or mood.
example: Hello Ravi, how are you?

meaning: Words you say to show you are grateful.
example: Thank you for your help.

meaning: A greeting you say in the early part of the day.
example: Good morning, sir, did you sleep well?

meaning: Words you say before going to bed or at night.
example: Good night, sleep well.

meaning: Used to say that you accept a plan or idea.
example: Agreed, let us meet at five.

meaning: Used when you wish that something will happen.
example: Hopefully, it will not rain tomorrow.

meaning: Completely; used for strong agreement.
example: I totally agree with you.

meaning: In every way; fully.
example: I completely forgot about the meeting.

meaning: Not any longer; no more.
example: I do not drink coffee anymore.

meaning: Used to ask why or for what reason something happened.
example: How come you are not at school today?

meaning: Used to ask if someone knows or can guess something.
example: Any idea where my phone charger is?
exampleTamil: என் போன் சார்ஜர் எங்கே இருக்கிறது என்று ஏதாவது தெரியுமா?

meaning: A period of very hot weather that lasts for several days.
example: The heatwave made it hard to sleep at night.
exampleTamil: வெப்ப அலையால் இரவில் தூங்குவது கடினமாக இருந்தது.

meaning: Wonderful; extremely good.
example: You look fabulous in that saree.

meaning: Said when you are shocked or alarmed.
example: Yikes, the bill is so high!

meaning: A mild word showing surprise.
example: Gosh, is it already ten o'clock?

meaning: Said when you are surprised or did not understand.
example: Huh? Can you say that again?

meaning: Said when you suddenly understand something.
example: Aha, now I understand the problem!

meaning: Said when you feel worried or sorry about something.
example: Oh dear, I left my phone at home.

meaning: Said when you are surprised or annoyed.
example: Good grief, look at this traffic!

meaning: Is easy to understand or seems reasonable.
example: Your plan makes sense to me.

meaning: Said when you have understood something.
example: Got it, I will send the file today.

meaning: Said when you want to join a plan.
example: Count me in for the picnic!

meaning: A casual way to say it was your mistake.
example: Oh, my bad, I took your seat.
exampleTamil: ஓ, என் தவறு, நான் உன் இருக்கையை எடுத்துக்கொண்டேன்.

meaning: In the present time, as compared with the past.
example: Everyone seems to be busy these days.
exampleTamil: இந்த நாட்களில் எல்லோரும் பிஸியாக இருப்பதாகத் தெரிகிறது.

meaning: At this very moment, or immediately.
example: Please come to the kitchen right now.

meaning: Time when you are not working and can do what you like.
example: I read stories in my free time.
exampleTamil: என் ஓய்வு நேரத்தில் நான் கதைகள் படிப்பேன்.

meaning: Said to warn someone to avoid danger.
example: Be careful, the floor is wet.

meaning: Said to warn someone about danger.
example: Watch out for the bike behind you!

meaning: A polite way to tell a guest to take what they want.
example: There are snacks on the table, so please help yourself.

meaning: Used to say you are curious and want to know something.
example: I wonder what time the bus will come.
exampleTamil: பேருந்து எத்தனை மணிக்கு வரும் என்று எனக்குத் தெரியவில்லை.

meaning: To get together with someone by plan.
example: Let us meet up after class.

meaning: A friendly way of saying goodbye for now.
example: See you on Monday at school.

meaning: Words used to get attention or to say politely sorry.
example: Excuse me, where is the bus stop?

meaning: A casual way of praising someone.
example: Nice one, that was a great catch!

meaning: A casual question meaning how are you or what is happening.
example: Hey Anu, what's up?

meaning: A polite answer when someone thanks you.
example: You're welcome, I was happy to help.

meaning: A polite way to let someone go first.
example: After you, please go in first.
exampleTamil: நீங்கள் முதலில் செல்லுங்கள், தயவுசெய்து உள்ளே போங்கள்.

meaning: Said to tell someone that something is not a problem.
example: That's fine, you can pay me later.

meaning: Words you say to ask someone to wait a short time.
example: One moment, please, I will check.

meaning: Words asking someone to wait for a short time.
example: Just a minute, I am on the phone.

meaning: Friendly words said when meeting someone.
example: He sent festival greetings to everyone.

meaning: Exactly as the words say; used also to add emphasis.
example: I literally waited for two hours.
exampleTamil: நான் சத்தியமாக இரண்டு மணி நேரம் காத்திருந்தேன்.

meaning: At a later time; after something has happened.
example: We had dinner and watched TV afterwards.
exampleTamil: நாங்கள் இரவு உணவு சாப்பிட்டு பின்னர் டிவி பார்த்தோம்.

meaning: Earlier than a particular time or event.
example: Please tell me beforehand if you cannot come.

meaning: Perhaps; it may be true or may happen.
example: I can possibly come on Sunday.

meaning: Of course; as you would expect.
example: Naturally, I said yes to the invitation.

meaning: Used to agree strongly or to add emphasis.
example: It was indeed a very good meal.

meaning: In a plain way; or only.
example: Please explain it simply.

meaning: A word showing sadness about something.
example: Alas, the shop was already closed.

meaning: Light, friendly conversation about simple things.
example: We made small talk while waiting for the bus.

meaning: Friendly, casual talk about unimportant things.
example: Stop the chitchat and finish your work.

meaning: The time between two events.
example: Dinner is not ready; in the meantime, have some tea.
exampleTamil: இரவு உணவு தயாராகவில்லை; அதற்குள் தேநீர் குடியுங்கள்.

meaning: A short trip you take for fun, usually with friends or family.
example: Our school arranged an outing to the zoo.
exampleTamil: எங்கள் பள்ளி மிருகக்காட்சிசாலைக்கு ஒரு உல்லாசப் பயணம் ஏற்பாடு செய்தது.

meaning: To meet and spend time with other people.
example: Our family will get together for Pongal.

meaning: To visit someone for a very short time.
example: I will pop in to see you on my way.
exampleTamil: போகும் வழியில் உன்னைச் சற்று பார்த்துவிட்டுப் போகிறேன்.

meaning: Exactly; used to agree strongly.
example: That is precisely what I wanted to say.

meaning: Friendly, playful talk between people.
example: I enjoy the banter with my colleagues.
exampleTamil: என் சக ஊழியர்களுடன் கேலியாகப் பேசுவது எனக்குப் பிடிக்கும்.

meaning: Fast, continuous, friendly talk about small things.
example: I could hear the chatter of children outside.

meaning: A very short moment of time.
example: It was over in an instant.

meaning: The soft light after sunset before it gets dark.
example: We sat outside in the twilight.

meaning: The darker part of the evening just before night.
example: Birds return to their nests at dusk.

meaning: In a way that shows good manners.
example: She politely asked him to wait.

meaning: A polite way to say sorry or ask someone to repeat.
example: Pardon me, I did not catch your name.

meaning: Said politely to someone who has just sneezed.
example: Bless you! Do you have a cold?

meaning: To wait happily for something that will happen.
example: I look forward to meeting you.
